<subject>OrionLink Solutions for Years 2000/2001</subject>
<body>
Since Shirley and I are planning to be at Nexus Tower tomorrow, we are providing you our laundry list of year end network IBIT items for discussion at your meeting tomorrow.

FYI, if we have more items than you need in total, the items I would prefer to pull back first would be the OrionLink Solutions payment, the CRTC compliance user fees, and the capitalization of specialized engineering overheads.

Please let us know how you wish to proceed.
